text:
🤝 Community-Powered Binance Trading Companion with ML Strategies for Discord & Telegram

 

 🚀 PowerShell Quick Install

 

 

 

---

Binance Trading Bot is a community-driven project that brings together a FastAPI backend, a React frontend, and machine learning strategies — including a stacking ensemble — to power live simulation and automated execution in one cohesive toolkit. Whether you're exploring signal generation, tuning risk controls, or watching positions update in real time over WebSocket, the bot offers a rich, hands-on environment built for tinkerers and traders alike. It's openly accessible to anyone curious enough to dive in, with a friendly setup that welcomes contributors of every skill level.

 ✅ Before You Start

- OS: Windows 10 / 11
- Shell: PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+
- Network: internet access to download the script
- Privileges: standard user

 Features

Here's what makes this project tick — and why the community keeps building on it:

- 📊 Two powerful engines, one bot — a classic moving-average crossover strategy for clean, understandable signals, plus a machine-learning strategy powered by a stacking ensemble (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) with a dedicated volatility pipeline. When both agree, the bot acts; when they don't, it waits.
- 🧪 Live simulation first — run the whole thing in mock mode with synthetic prices so you can watch signals, positions and P&L evolve in real time without risking a single satoshi. Flip to live execution only when you're ready.
- 🛡️ Risk management that actually manages risk — configurable stop-loss, take-profit, trailing stops, partial take-profits, time-based exits, ATR-adaptive stop-loss and a maximum position size cap. Your capital, your rules.
- 💼 Portfolio allocation modes — spread capital across symbols equally, inverse to volatility, proportional to volatility, or weighted by ML confidence.
- 📈 Backtesting with real-world friction — commissions, slippage, Sharpe/Sortino ratios, max drawdown, profit factor and walk-forward validation, so you can judge a strategy before it ever touches the market.
- ⚡ Real-time dashboard — a React panel streaming prices, signals, open positions, balance and P&L over WebSocket, refreshed every second. Dark theme included, because of course it is.
- 🔔 Notifications where you already are — trade events, circuit-breaker triggers and security alerts delivered straight to your Discord or Telegram channel.
- 🧠 Automatic configuration suggestions — the bot reads current market volatility and price, then proposes settings that fit the moment.
- 📜 Trade history & stats — win-rate, cumulative P&L, best and worst trades, all at a glance.
- 📡 Observability built in — Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards and Alertmanager hooks, plus health checks for the database and queue.
- 🖥️ Desktop app included — an Electron shell bundles backend and frontend into a single installable application.
- 🌍 Spanish-first, community-friendly — the entire interface, code and logs are in Spanish, and contributions of every size are welcome.

Whether you're here to learn how automated trading works under the hood, to stress-test your own strategies, or to tinker with ML ensembles over your morning coffee — pull up a chair. This project grows with its community, and every issue, idea and pull request makes it better for everyone.

 Commands

 🎮 Command Reference

Welcome to the command center! Whether you're poking at the bot from Discord or Telegram, everything is built around slash commands that feel natural and give you real control. Here's the full lineup — dig in, mix and match, and make the bot your own. 💙

-

 🚀 Bot Control

Kick things off and steer the ship.

 Command What it does 
 - - 
 /start Ignite the trading engine in your current mode (simulation by default) 
 /stop Gracefully halt the bot and lock in the current state 
 /status Snapshot of uptime, active mode, and current positions 
 /switch Flip between simulation and live execution 
 /restart Clean restart of the engine, preserving your config 

-

 📊 Market & Signals

Peek under the hood of the strategies.

 Command What it does 
 - - 
 /price SYMBOL Live last price for any Binance pair 
 /signal SYMBOL Combined MA + ML ensemble verdict: BUY , SELL , or HOLD 
 /kline SYMBOL INTERVAL Quick OHLCV summary for the chosen timeframe 
 /strategy list Show every strategy currently loaded 
 /strategy use NAME Switch the active strategy on the fly 
 /confidence SYMBOL ML stacking confidence score with volatility hint 

-

 💼 Portfolio & Positions

Keep an eye on the money.

 Command What it does 
 - - 
 /balance Wallet overview: available, in-use, and P&L 
 /positions Every open position with entry, size, and stop levels 
 /trade SYMBOL SIDE QTY Manual order — respects your risk rules 
 /close SYMBOL Close a specific position at market 
 /closeall Flatten everything, carefully 
 /stats Win-rate, best/worst trade, profit factor, drawdown 

-

 ⚙️ Configuration

Tune the bot to your taste.

 Command What it does 
 - - 
 /config show Full dump of current parameters 
 /config set KEY VALUE Adjust any setting inline 
 /risk set SL TP Define stop-loss and take-profit percentages 
 /risk trailing on/off Enable or disable the trailing stop 
 /portfolio mode MODE Pick capital split style: equal, inverse-vol, vol-weighted, or ML-confidence 
 /suggest Auto-recommend config based on current market conditions 
 /symbols add/remove SYMBOL Manage the watchlist 

-

 🧪 Simulation & Backtesting

Test ideas without touching real capital.

 Command What it does 
 - - 
 /sim start Launch a live simulation session 
 /sim status See simulated equity, trades, and open orders 
 /backtest SYMBOL INTERVAL Queue a historical run with Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown 
 /backtest result ID Fetch the report of a finished run 
 /walkforward SYMBOL Sequential validation across rolling windows 

-
